about: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Standard Edition includes PS4 & PS5 games†.
The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.

Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. The latest update introduces a brand-new international tournament mode featuring 48 national teams, alongside new authentic stadiums to play in.
Take on international-themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.

Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience shaped by community feedback, Manager Live Challenges that deliver fresh scenarios throughout the season, and new Archetypes inspired by greats of the game.
Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team™ with new Live Events and Tournament modes, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience.
